subject: Web Development
title: Electron: Desktop Apps in JavaScript
description: A short lesson to help you apply Electron: Desktop Apps in JavaScript.

hook.text: What if you could build a desktop app using only web technologies?

buildup.text: Electron wraps a web page in a Chromium shell, creating standalone desktop applications.

discovery.text: VS Code, Slack, Discord, and Figma all run on Electron. JavaScript powers your desktop.

twist.text: Each Electron app ships its own browser, consuming hundreds of megabytes of RAM.

climax.text: Critics call it bloated. Users keep downloading Electron apps anyway.

punchline.text: Your desktop apps are secret web pages.

quiz.question: What does Electron wrap web pages in?
